title: Here’s How Quickly Items Sell on AptDeco
summary: If you're considering selling on AptDeco, this is exactly how quickly you can expect your item to sell depending on the category.
body_markdown:
#### How quickly can your item can sell on AptDeco? Here’s what you need to know.


If you’ve[sold on Apt­De­co](http://aptdeco.com/sell) before, you’ve seen us brag about how fast items can sell, and it’s true! Here are some quick tips on how to make sure your item goes quickly.


- Items from[top brands](https://www.aptdeco.com/brands/top-brands) sell faster than less­er known brands. That includes West Elm, Pot­tery Barn, CB2, Crate & Bar­rel, IKEA, Restora­tion Hard­ware, Room & Board and Way­fair.[Browse pop­u­lar brands here](https://www.aptdeco.com/brands/top-brands) .
- Items prices more than 50% off retail go fast. Apt­De­co buy­ers like qual­i­ty, but they also like a deal.
- Make sure your list­ing includes a man­u­fac­tur­er link and the orig­i­nal retail price, when avail­able. That helps buy­ers com­par­i­son shop and con­firms the steep sav­ings off retail.
- Anoth­er fac­tor to con­sid­er? The **** type** of item you’re sell­ing. Some items sell quick­er than oth­ers, like sofas, desks, beds, and stor­age like dressers, media con­soles, and cre­den­zas. These items are always pop­u­lar with Apt­De­co buyers!
